title: NWP500 external control intent, protocol 0
description: An intent document tells the integration's external control feature what the heater should do and when. Top-level keys are attributes of the intent entity. Rules that span fields (valid_until after issued_at, unique directive ids, window ordering, the overlap rules, and the device's capability limits) are checked by the feature and are listed in docs/external-control.md.

protocol.description: Protocol version. A major version the feature does not support rejects the document (unsupported_protocol).

intent_id.description: Unique per intent. The intent entity's state must change on every new intent; use this.

issued_at.description: When the scheduler made the intent. ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

valid_until.description: After this the intent is stale and the heater is restored to the baseline. Must be later than issued_at. ISO 8601 with a UTC offset.

directives.description: Ordered by start. An empty list is an explicit 'no intent': run on the baseline.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 with a UTC offset. Naive timestamps are rejected.

mode_name.description: vacation and power_off are never accepted in a directive.

id.description: Unique within the intent. Named in acknowledgements.

charge.description: From start, heat until the tank reaches the target or end arrives, whichever is first. end is the latest the charge may run. Completion is the compressor stopping, never 'reached setpoint'.

hold_off.description: No heating starts in the window, whether or not the heater would start on its own, within the limits of what a lowered setpoint can prevent. Supported only once the owner has enabled it in the options.

request.description: true marks a person's request: a cycle it starts, or one already running when it arrives, runs to completion.

mode.description: Run in that operation mode for the window. The mode must be in the capability entity's allowed_modes.

surplus_grant.description: While the compressor is already running and the configured surplus signal is on, the setpoint may be raised up to the maximum. Requires a configured surplus entity.
